name: Geetanjali Credit and Capital Limited
about: Geetanjali Credit and Capital Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in providing financial and other related services business in India. It focuses on financing, inter-corporate investments, and capital market activities. The company was formerly known as Shubh International Limited and changed its name to Geetanjali Credit and Capital Limited in July 2002. Geetanjali Credit and Capital Limited was incorporated in 1990 and is based in Dharwad, India.
